title: Olimpia Milano repeat as Serie A champions
description: Milano - Virtus BO 67-55 Milano defended their Serie A title. They overcame Virtus Bologna in the decisive seventh game of the title series to repeat as the champions. The victory marked the 30th Serie A title in Milano history. The game was mostly controlled by Milano. Virtus BO managed to win second period 20-17. But it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. They dominated on the defensive end, holding Virtus BO to just 5 points in third quarter. It was a great evening for the former international forward Luigi Datome (203-1987) who led his team to a victory scoring 16 points. Danish Shavon Shields (201-1994, college: Nebraska) helped adding 10 points, 5 rebounds, 5 assists and 4 steals.
